blind.description: A fantasy architectural flying buttress piece made of warm beige cut stone. It features a vertical square pillar on a stepped plinth, topped with a golden pyramid finial cap and decorated on the outer side with a golden sunburst emblem with red recesses. Projecting outward from the pillar is a curved buttress arm/arch, topped along its upper ridge with five sharp golden pyramidal spikes and ending in a flat vertical abutment interface.
blind.from_above: A square golden pyramidal finial on a square stone column head on the left, extending rightward into a long, narrow straight wall/beam lined with five golden pyramidal spikes along its crest.
blind.height_vs_figure: The pillar stands around 7 feet tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure), with the buttress spanning roughly 5 to 6 feet in length.

notes: footprint proportion 2.09x off the catalog (6.3 x 2.3 ft)
